methods.name: authenticateAccessToken
methods.errorHandling: Throws JsonWebTokenError / TokenExpiredError on invalid token, maps to public exceptions.
methods.failClosed: Fail-closed on any verification failure (rejects authentication).

methods.name: getActorSnapshot
methods.errorHandling: Throws ActorNotFoundError if user does not exist.
methods.failClosed: Returns undefined or throws on missing database record.

catalog.correlationIdHandling: Propagated via nest context and AsyncLocalStorage where active.
